# SonderMind

> SonderMind connects patients with licensed mental health providers and offers clinical resources for therapists, psychiatrists, and health systems.

SonderMind operates a comprehensive mental health platform serving patients, clinicians, health systems, and payors. The platform includes a provider directory, clinical tools, research insights, and educational content focused on therapy and psychiatric care.

## Key Topics

- Therapy
- Psychiatry
- Mental Health Care
- Provider Directory
- Clinical Resources
- Mental Health Providers
- Health Systems
- Patient Information
- Therapist Tools
- Mental Health Data
- Clinical Research
- Insurance
- Military Community
- Veteran Health
- Research Insights

## Provider Directory & Services

- [Find a Therapist | SonderMind](https://www.sondermind.com/provider-directory): Therapist directory with search filters to find licensed providers

## Clinical Resources & Tools

- [Resources for Mental Health Care Clinicians](https://www.sondermind.com/resources/clinical-resources): Clinical resources and tools for mental health providers and therapists

## Patient Education & Content

- [Mental Health Care Articles and Content](https://www.sondermind.com/resources/articles-and-content): Mental health articles and educational content for patients and clinicians

## Research & Insights

- [Research](https://www.sondermind.com/research): SonderMind research insights and mental health publications and data
